high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "factzone." The post features a vibrant photograph of a peacock in mid-flight, showcasing its colorful tail feathers spread out dramatically against a light sky background. The peacock's body is oriented vertically, with its head at the top and its tail feathers fanned out below. Below the image, there is a bold yellow banner with the text "DID YOU KNOW?" in white capital letters. Underneath the banner, the caption reads: "This is how Peacocks look in midflight. Only few people are blessed to see this view.
